mapper.select: SELECT t1.ID ID, COUNT( t2.CHANNEL_ID ) channelNum FROM sg_tccon_tcopticalroad_b t1 LEFT JOIN sg_tccon_tcopticalroad_r_tcchannelseg t2 ON t2.OPTICALROAD_ID = t1.ID GROUP BY t1.ID

SELECT t1.ID ID, COUNT( t3.FIBERSEG_ID ) segNum FROM sg_tccon_tcopticalroad_b t1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROUTER_ID, FIBER_ID FROM sg_tccon_tcrouter_r_fiber GROUP BY ROUTER_ID, FIBER_ID ) t2 ON t2.ROUTER_ID = t1.ID LEFT JOIN SG_TCDEV_FIBERSEG_R_FIBER t3 ON t3.FIBER_ID = t2.FIBER_ID GROUP BY t1.ID

SELECT t1.ID ID, COUNT( t3.FIBERSEGLINE_ID ) segLineNum FROM sg_tccon_tcopticalroad_b t1 LEFT JOIN sg_tccon_tcrouter_r_fiber t2 ON t2.ROUTER_ID = t1.ID LEFT JOIN sg_tccon_fiberline_r_fibersegline t3 ON t3.FIBERLINE_ID = t2.LINE_ID GROUP BY t1.ID

SELECT t1.ID ID, sum( FIBER_LENGTH ) routeLength FROM sg_tccon_tcopticalroad_b t1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROUTER_ID, FIBER_ID FROM sg_tccon_tcrouter_r_fiber GROUP BY ROUTER_ID, FIBER_ID ) t2 ON t2.ROUTER_ID = t1.ID LEFT JOIN SG_TCDEV_FIBER_B t3 ON t3.ID = t2.FIBER_ID GROUP BY t1.ID
select ID from SG_TCCON_TCOPTICALROAD_S where ID = #{optical}
mapper.update: update SG_TCCON_TCOPTICALROAD_S set CHANNEL_NUM = #{channelNum}, SEG_NUM = #{segNum}, SEG_LINE_NUM = #{segLineNum}, ROUTE_LENGTH = #{routeLength}, STAMP = now(), update_date =now() where ID = #{id}
